# Filthy Rich

Ponyville's well-to-do shopkeeper, Diamond Tiara's father and Spoiled Rich's husband. He runs Rich's Barnyard Bargains, which grew out of his grandfather Stinkin' Rich's trade in Granny Smith's Zap Apple Jam. Although he can be a tough negotiator, he is generally courteous and considerably less snobbish than his wife.

[![Filthy Rich and Diamond Tiara at Sweet Apple Acres — Hasbro / DHX Media, Friendship is Magic](https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-YcEwtw8Fal8/UmmhCYDMNmI/AAAAAAABk18/WaX9p6Gvp_c/s1600/Granny_Smith_notices_Filthy_Rich_S2E12.png)](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2013/10/3766-days-of-pony-family-appreciation.html)

- **Appearance:** Tan earth-pony stallion, slick dark-gray mane and tail, blue eyes, white collar, navy lapels and a red dollar-sign tie. His cutie mark is three money bags. [Color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/150-Filthy-Rich)
- **Name and voice:** Filthy Rich is his official television name, introduced in Family Appreciation Day (January 7, 2012); he prefers to be called Rich. Berry Rich is an alternate merchandise name on a Wave 22 blind-bag figure, not a fan name or separate identity. He has speaking roles, voiced in English by Brian Drummond. [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Filthy_Rich)
- **Other appearances:** Slice of Life (S5E9), It Isn't the Mane Thing About You (S7E19) and The Ending of the End – Part 2 (S9E25). In IDW's [Election comic arc](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Election), issues #46–47, he briefly becomes Ponyville's mayor. His separate human-world counterpart threatens to redevelop Camp Everfree in [Equestria Girls: Legend of Everfree](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=57699).

[![Father's Day 2012 — fan art by John Joseco](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/9/4886__safe_artist-colon-johnjoseco_derpibooru%2Bimport_diamond%2Btiara_filthy%2Brich_earth%2Bpony_pony_cute_diamondbetes_equestria%27s%2Bbest%2Bfather_father_fathe.jpeg)](https://twibooru.org/4886)

## Important moments

- **Teaching Diamond Tiara respect — [Family Appreciation Day (S2E12)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lLuwGNGnmQo).** He insists that his reluctant daughter participate in Granny Smith's jam-making traditions, despite her earlier ridicule of them.
- **Money as a superpower — [Do Princesses Dream of Magic Sheep? (S5E13)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OmYN2g4z_CE).** In Ponyville's shared dream, he turns his wealth into a stream of bits to fight the Tantabus.
- **Funding a better playground — [Crusaders of the Lost Mark (S5E18)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=byT8p0pQWbg).** At Diamond Tiara's request, he provides money to repair the school playground, helping her put her newfound generosity into action.
- **The nearly disastrous cider deal — [Where the Apple Lies (S6E23)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B81vN2359fo).** His threatened withdrawal of business after young Applejack makes a premature deal sets off the chain of lies that teaches her the value of honesty.
